title: Jake Dagget
description: Reads LGBT books to his 1st grade students.
body:
# Jake Dagget

# Elementary Teacher

![](/media/uploads/2026/01/dagget-profile.png)

- Admits that he talks to his elementary students about their identities.

![](/media/uploads/2026/04/tosa-02.jpg)

- Uses his classroom to promote LGBT books to his 1st grade students.

![](/media/uploads/2026/01/daggett.png)

- Calls his **[first grade students](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/fc1c5947-d819-4472-814c-61fd39ccd9d8/WI-Wauwatosa-Daggert-Friends.png)** his “friends.”
